meta.frame: x along the axis from the left (west) abutment face to the right (east) bank; y along the flow, positive downstream (north). Levels in project EL; model metres = EL + params.datum.offset_m.
meta.bank_convention: left and right looking downstream; the river flows south to north, so left = west (Keromongan), right = east (Perjaya)

lon.note: centre of the OpenStreetMap weir line

lat.note: centre of the OpenStreetMap weir line

bearing_deg.note: direction from the left (west) abutment to the right (east) abutment; the OSM line runs 104.38003,-4.30513 to 104.38198,-4.30510 (within 1 deg of 90)

flow_bearing_deg.note: the river crosses the weir flowing north (checked on the D8 flow grid)

length_m.note: abutment to abutment; the OSM line is 217 m and imagery 217 +/- 3 m (r08)

type.v: gated barrage (bendung gerak): all bays gated, no fixed overflow crest

left_width_m.note: what is left of 215.5 m after 177.5 m of gates and nine 3.0 m piers, split evenly between the two abutments

count.note: ten bays need nine piers between them

width_m.note: main bays 22.9 m centre to centre on imagery minus the 20.0 m gate; sluice bays 15.5 m minus 12.5 m

alt.note: 38.0 m of non-gate length split over nine piers with no abutments (earlier settled assumption)

type_3d.v: vertical-lift roller gate with a flap on top
type_3d.note: flaps from a student paper (weak); roller lift gates are the type of the 1981 design; hoist towers on every pier fit a lifting gate; real type not found

flap_h_m.note: height of the top flap leaf; the paper's flaps pass 9.36 m3/s in the first 0.1 m, no drawing found

colour_top.note: a thin orange-red line along all gate tops on aerials

lift_max_m.note: full lift clears the tallest leaf (4.2 m) out of the water with a 0.3 m margin

el.note: 2.0 m over the design high water EL 81.00; no drawing found

band_width_m.note: deck band including the hoist towers seen from above, 12 +/- 2 m

road_width_m.note: two-lane rural road (the secondary road crosses on the weir)

tower_footprint_m.note: each hoist tower about 6 x 8 m (+/- 2 m), one on each pier; grey concrete, flat grey roof

tower_height_m.note: above the deck: room to lift the tallest leaf clear plus the hoist housing; no drawing found

road.v: secondary road on the weir deck (OSM bridge 222 m)

length_m.note: OSM bridge way along the weir

railing_h_m.note: usual road railing height; not resolvable on imagery

between.note: on the pier between the flood bays and the sluice bays

upstream_m.note: about 50-68 m upstream (south) of the axis on imagery (the note's compass words are swapped, CONTRACT A1)

downstream_m.note: +/- 3 m downstream (north) of the axis (the note's compass words are swapped, CONTRACT A1)

floor_el.note: 1 m below the bed EL 74.0 at the axis, 0.7 m below the under-sluice floor

pond_normal_el.note: normal pond held by the gates: the intake water level of the O&M spec sheet (CONTRACT A5)

design_high_water_el.note: reached only in the design flood with every gate open

pond_min_intake_el.note: one 0.1 m gate step under the normal pond 79.70: the lowest pond at which the intake is still taken as giving its design flow

riverbed_el.note: bed at the weir axis in the 1981 design's own project datum: crest 79.30 minus height 5.3; the Manning section below the weir uses tail_bed_el instead

tailwater_flood_case_el.note: downstream level in the paper's overflow case (weak)

tail_bed_el.note: Manning section b 200 m, side slope 1:2, n 0.035, S 0.00042: 2200 m3/s needs depth 5.77 m; bed = tail EL 80.00 - 5.77 = 74.23. (The terrain's tail surface, EL 78.2 on the survey days, is no longer an anchor.)

bank.note: office, settling basins and canal head all lie east of the weir

x_m.note: centre about 10 m beyond the right abutment, along the east bank

y_m.note: centre about 30 m upstream of the axis in the pocket behind the divide wall; a gated bank structure about 54 m long is seen there

face_bearing_deg.note: gates face west into the pond pocket; channels run east then curve north (r08)

leaves.note: slide-gate leaves; about 6 housings are seen on the photo (r08)

sill_el.note: 79.70 - 0.20 lip cover - 1.17 m opening; opening = 91.68 / (0.80 x 49.5 x sqrt(2g x 0.20)) = 1.17 m (KP-02 eq 5-3)

design_wl_el.note: intake design water level = normal pond (CONTRACT A5)

alt.note: Phase I design and operator figure, kept as the operating target

feed_channels.note: four parallel concrete-lined channels run east then north

gate_h_m.note: from the sill 78.30 up to the design high water 81.00, so the closed intake holds the flood

count.note: 3 built in Phase I, 2 added in Phase II

centre.note: Bak Desilting Perjaya, right bank just below the weir

width_m.note: imagery: bulbs about 44 +/- 4 m wide, 50 m centre to centre (r08)

long_axis_bearing_deg.note: basins run along the flow; their downstream (north) ends join a collector

slot.v: between SG3 and the right abutment
slot.note: east side is sourced; the exact slot is not

point.note: start of the OSM irrigation canal toward Belitang
